newsitem.title: USA: Dain Bosworth opens fixed income office in Memphis.
newsitem.headline: Dain Bosworth opens fixed income office in Memphis.

text.p: Dain Bosworth Inc announced Monday it has opened a fixed-income capital markets office in Memphis with seven professionals and room to add 20 employees.
Minneapolis-based Dain Bosworth, a subsidiary of Interra Financial Inc, also has fixed income sales offices in Boston, Chicago, Denver, New York City and Seattle.

"Dain Bosworth has one of the nation's top-ranked fixed income trading desks and we plan to leverage that resource by adding sales people in key markets throughout the country, including Memphis," national sales manager Ric Pedersen said.
Thomas Lunsford, Geoffrey Smith, Jonathan Duke and George Holstead have joined Dain Bosworth as vice presidents and institutional investment executives in the Memphis office, the firm announced.
Lunsford will lead recruitment and Smith will manage the office as well, the firm said.

Kirk Stebbins, a senior research analyst, has also joined the Memphis office.

"While Memphis is outside the northwestern region, where we serve individual investors and small businesses, it is a very attractive market because of the size of its institutional fixed income sales force," Pedersen said.
